source_row.extraction_instructions: Drupal 10. The events page is JS-rendered from /jsonapi/index/events (field_event_start/end, field_location, field_link, path alias); the listing reads that JSON in the browser. The flagship The Liver Meeting is NOT in the index: it lives on the /tlm-NN/home microsite (found via the nav link) with fees on /tlm-NN/event-registration. Application-only programmes are skipped; webinars are included when dated (fee read from the LiverLearning page).

registry_comment: AASLD - Drupal JSON:API /jsonapi/index/events (browser), plus The Liver Meeting microsite (/tlm-NN/home + /event-registration) which the index omits

concerns: Listing path: Drupal JSON:API the events page itself calls (found by watching XHR); the page's 'load more' pages that call, extractor walks offset in 50s. The index only lists UPCOMING items (4 now).

The Liver Meeting is NOT in the index (own microsite, nav link on the events page, found by regex). Its dates are parsed from home-page prose ('begin ... Thursday, November 5 ... conclude on Monday, November 9') and venue from 'will be held at the X in City, State'; if either parse fails the shell is dropped with a warning (no invented values). A new year's microsite (tlm-27) would be picked up if the nav link points to it.

TLM fee grid: the rendered DOM keeps only the default category tab, so fees are read from the server HTML via fetch_html (all 5 category blocks), with the browser as fallback. Trainee and Associate happen to share prices ($900/$470) on the site. Regular registration deadline (7 Oct) has passed; the page still shows these rates and no late/onsite rate, so none is stored. TLM CE credit count is on a separate page (not read), cpd_points None.

Skipped: '2027 AGA-AASLD Academic Skills Workshop' (application-only, applications closed 5 Oct 2026, no register link; detected by the page text). Included: the LEAN MASLD webinar (27 Oct, online, workshop, $0.00 read from the LiverLearning page, registration required).

Coverage checklist verified: same-site registration page (TLM, followed), external registration (my.aasld.org/compusystems are login/Salesforce portals, not parsed, fees were on aasld.org), PDFs (Abstract Supplement only), CTA text (booking_url stays the aasld.org page; register link not used). Spring ETC says the junior-investigator call for abstracts 'will be announced soon': stored as abstract_deadline_note.
Possible shared change: wordpress_generic.location_from_ld raises on a list-valued JSON-LD location name (AttributeError); aasld.py retries without ld+json. Fix in the family would be a one-liner.
